guideline: Specificity 0: Broad (no more than 20 papers fit the question)
Specificity 1: Specific (no more than 5 papers fit the question)
Quality 0: Discarded (factually wrong, unrealistic, overly broad/specific, or too easy)
Quality 1: Acceptable (somewhat out of distribution or relatively easy)
Quality 2: Good (challenging and meaningful literature search question)

overall_notes: This paper is primarily a retrieval benchmark paper (LitSearch) focused on scientific literature search, not an NLG evaluation paper. While it involves question generation by GPT-4, the main contribution is evaluating retrieval systems, not evaluating NLG outputs. The automatic metrics and human evaluations are used to assess retrieval performance, not NLG quality. The LLM-as-judge (GPT-4o reranking) is used for retrieval evaluation, not NLG output evaluation.
